original_rate.display_name: "อัตราดอกเบี้ยรายวันเดิม (%) / Original Daily Interest (%)"
original_rate.initial_value_oltp: IF([Principal Amount] > 0, IFS(AND([Loan Type] = "ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน", ISNOTBLANK([Current Daily Interest])), ROUND(100.0 * [Current Daily Interest] / [Principal Amount]), AND([Loan Type] = "กำหนดวันชำระ", ISNOTBLANK([Fixed Interest]), ISNOTBLANK([Loan Date]), ISNOTBLANK([Due Date]), [Due Date] >= [Loan Date]), ROUND(100.0 * [Fixed Interest] / (TOTALHOURS([Due Date] - [Loan Date]) / 24 + 1) / [Principal Amount]), AND([Loan Type] = "ผ่อนชำระรายวัน", ISNOTBLANK([Daily Payment Amount]), ISNOTBLANK([Loan Date]), ISNOTBLANK([Due Date]), [Due Date] >= [Loan Date]), ROUND(100.0 * (([Daily Payment Amount] * (TOTALHOURS([Due Date] - [Loan Date]) / 24 + 1)) - [Principal Amount]) / (TOTALHOURS([Due Date] - [Loan Date]) / 24 + 1) / [Principal Amount])), NUMBER(""))

loan_key.oltp: CONCATENATE([Borrower Name TE], "-", TEXT([Principal Amount]), "-", TEXT([Loan Date], "DD/MM"), "-", IF(ISBLANK([Original Daily Interest Rate]), "Unavailable", CONCATENATE([Original Daily Interest Rate], "%")))
loan_key.olap: CONCATENATE([Borrower Name], "-", TEXT([Principal Amount]), "-", TEXT([Loan Date], "DD/MM"), "-", IF(ISBLANK([Original Daily Interest Rate]), "Unavailable", CONCATENATE([Original Daily Interest Rate], "%")))

current_daily_interest.valid_if: OR([Loan Type] <> "ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน", [Current Daily Interest] > 0, AND([Current Daily Interest] = 0, IN([Row ID], Loans[Row ID]), ISNOTBLANK([Original Daily Interest Rate])))
